summary: Iteration 3 verification of iteration_2 fixes + new Opportunity Radar 3-pane. Backend pytest 25/25 pass (108.78s, incl. 2 LLM runs: ana.briefing + catherine.assess). Did 1 additional LLM run (ana.briefing) to confirm em-dash sanitising (U+2014 count=0). Frontend: Shell nav duplication fixed (main-nav count=1 on desktop, mobile-nav absent until drawer opens, 13 desktop nav-* items, 0 m-nav-* when drawer closed). All 6 regression rooms (Daily, Narrative, Founder, Launch, Content, Radar) load with correct current-room label and no error banner. Opportunity Radar 3-pane fully working: radar-lists + radar-detail panes visible, list-all/list-shortlisted filter rows correctly (7 total -> 1 shortlisted -> back to 7), compare checkboxes toggle without selecting a row (opp-compare-table renders, opp-detail stays at 0), clicking an opp-row opens opp-detail-<id> with Assess, DIANA campaign idea, Practical constraints, Consolidated next steps cards and opp-project-*/opp-reject-* buttons. Handoff context panels confirmed on both targets: story-to-content creates draft whose page shows handoff-context-panel; ws-handoff-founder creates workspace whose target shows ws-context-panel. ContentDesk BERDINE write/adapt UI inspected in code: load-generated-draft and save-adapted-draft testids are now present (ContentDesk.jsx lines 140 & 175), rendering conditionally when BERDINE output includes a draft (confirmed in iteration_2 behaviour and spec). No new LLM runs executed for Stage C to respect the 'about 3' budget.
critical_code_review_comments: Shell.jsx uses a single nav() factory parameterised by `mobile` to emit distinct testids (main-nav vs mobile-nav, nav-* vs m-nav-*). Clean fix; recommend extracting into its own Nav component once more props are added.
Radar.jsx is a single 209-line file with inline aside/main/aside grid. Working, but if more panes are added, extract OppDetailPanel and SavedLists into siblings for readability.

server.py no_dash runs on every LLM output and every chat delta. For long streams, a precompiled str.translate map would be marginally faster than .replace chains, but current traffic volume makes this a non-issue.
/api/c/<coll>/{id} delete returns {ok: true} regardless of whether the id existed - consider 404 for missing ids to match other DELETE semantics in the codebase. Low priority.
seed_data_creation: No new seed. Cleaned up test-created records: draft bb59aed9-d973-4273-9402-4709b1a2d0f7 (from story-to-content) and workspace cf71978e-0c35-4a3b-809f-d5c778fe938b (from ws-handoff-founder). Idempotent seeded worked-examples preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration_2 action items resolved: unique data-testids (main-nav/mobile-nav, nav-*/m-nav-*), load-generated-draft + save-adapted-draft present in ContentDesk Stage C (conditional on BERDINE output.draft), handoff-context-panel on drafts (ContentDesk.jsx:250) and ws-context-panel on workspaces (Room.jsx:102), backend no_dash() sanitises both run outputs and chat deltas. Radar 3-pane uses xl:grid-cols-[180px_1fr_420px]; opp-row click toggles setSelId; checkboxes stopPropagation so compare works without selecting. If LLM budget allows, exercise run-btn-berdine-write_draft -> load-generated-draft -> run-btn-berdine-adapt_channel (target=Substack) -> save-adapted-draft to confirm the two testids function (adds ~90s of LLM wait).
rca of the issue: N/A - all previously reported bugs are fixed in this iteration.
